description: Fast scaffold takeoff mode. Sum curve lengths from the current Revit selection, including detail lines, detail component family geometry, and filled region boundaries. Use this when the user manually traces the scaffold outline.

includeFamilyGeometry.description: Read measurable curve geometry from selected detail component family instances.

includeFilledRegions.description: Include selected filled region boundary curves.

minCurveLengthMm.description: Ignore tiny curve fragments shorter than this length.

scaffoldHeightMm.description: Optional scaffold height. When provided, the tool also returns perimeter x height area in square meters.

name: calculate_selected_detail_line_perimeter
title: Fast scaffold takeoff mode
